Squad Leader '''Naboo-1''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps/Legends|Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]]. He was active in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and was captured by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Rescue mission in Theed|rescued]] Naboo-1 and five other pilots before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|final stages of the invasion]]. Kenobi infiltrated the Royal Observatory where the pilots were held and freed them. The squad leader agreed to accompany Kenobi back to the [[Naboo Resistance]], but stated that the pilots would let Kenobi precede them. Kenobi led the pilots back to the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]], stopping them several times to engage Federation forces before joining back up with the resistance. Naboo-1 reported the success of their breakout to resistance leader [[Asha (Naboo)|Asha]] and requested access to the south entrance.

==Behind the scenes==
"Squad Leader" was voiced by [[Nick Jameson]] in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]. The mission "Captives of the Federation" in which this character appears contradicts the chronology of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The character identifies himself as "Naboo-1" during a communication transmission to Asha at the conclusion of the mission. It is unclear if this individual is supposed to represent [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]], the leader of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] who accompanied the Queen throughout the movie.
